QuestInfo.name: Welcome to the Neighborhood
QuestInfo.0: After touring the house, it finally hit you that you'll be here for a while. Talk to Silver for more information.
QuestInfo.1: According to Silver, the Pointy-Ear Foxes have a tradition of giving rice cakes to their neighbors whenever they move to a new place. Give the Brown Rice Cakes that you got from Silver to your neighbors.
QuestInfo.2: You gave out the Brown Rice Cakes, but still haven't gotten used to all the pity stares for your human ears and no tail. Probably not even worth explaining now.

0.0: I trust you liked the house. Good, good. Now is the time for you to meet your neighbors. Better get your rice cakes. Ahh, but you probably don't know about those. It's our tradition to give rice cakes to our new neighbors when we move somewhere new. It's a good way to make friends, and take their minds off of eating you.
0.1: I've got some rice cakes around here somewhere... Ahh, here they are. A little old, but they're so chewy no one will notice. Now, hurry along. Everyone knows about you, so they're probably wondering why you haven't brought their cakes yet. Get going, then. Go on!

yes.0: Here are your cakes. Run along now, and make a good impression.

no.0: Don't worry, I told everyone you're not to be eaten. They'll be quite friendly!

1.0: How did everything go? Goodness, you look worn out.

yes.0: Ahh, you got some housewarming gifts! See, foxes can be quite kind to those they do not intend to eat.

default.0: Go on. These cakes aren't getting any fresher. Quite the opposite, in fact.
